category_title: High-ability students who resist training and rely on rereading for memorization
scenario_title: Resisting new study strategies and expressing low self-esteem during SRL training
minimal_context: The student is examining the learning objectives for her modular math course and writing down which resources she will use to study.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: For this task, please examine the learning objectives for our math module and describe in writing which resources you will use to study.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I looked at the modules, but I'm not going to study differently. I already use many of the tactics presented in the training.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please write down the specific strategies you plan to use for these objectives.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just going to read the textbook chapters again. Like I wrote down, rereading and spacing can help me better memorize the material.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think about trying some of the other new strategies we discussed instead of just rereading?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not changing how I study. It's not going to make a difference anyway because everyone knows I am just dumb.
